name: Video thumbnail
note: A clear focal point with room for a title, readable at 160 pixels.

name: Magazine or book cover
note: Exact lettering on a tall frame with space kept for the title.

name: Portrait photo
note: A believable photograph of an adult, with hands and faces right.

name: Anime illustration
note: A drawn character piece: anatomy, following and a steady character matter more than photo skills.

name: Pet restyle
note: Your own pet from a photo, restyled, and still recognisably your pet.

name: Product shot
note: A clean studio photograph where materials read right and the frame does what it is told.

name: Storybook
note: The same character across pages in a painted style, following each scene.
